title: Adaptive confidence intervals with missing data
summary: We consider the construction of confidence intervals for population means when observations are subject to missingness. To accommodate more general missingness mechanisms than missing completely at random (MCAR), we adopt a reparametrised version of the realisable contamination model of Ma et al. (2026), which is a mixture of an MCAR version and a missing not at random version of the same base distribution $P$.
